_readme: S741, lane 2's cheap piles (2026-11-27). East Los Angeles 38168 (Commercial Music: Instrumental/Vocal Performer certificate) was read from the 'Commercial Music: Performance' section on PDF p.288, shared with 38169 and 38206; its note says no section carries its title. Each East Los Angeles section prints its Academic Plan code (E0 and the control number), so this read prints pp.286-290 whole: a session can see which section prints Academic Plan E038168D and what it lists. One load. No model call, nothing written.

questions.plan_38168: Which section on pp.286-290 prints Academic Plan E038168D, its heading, lists and total.
